name: playwright-cucumber-framework
description: Playwright UI and API test automation with Cucumber

scripts.test: mkdir -p reports && cucumber-js --format progress:reports/cucumber-progress.txt --format json > reports/cucumber.json
scripts.test:ui: mkdir -p reports && cucumber-js --tags @ui --format progress:reports/cucumber-progress.txt --format json > reports/cucumber.json
scripts.test:api: mkdir -p reports && cucumber-js --tags @api --format progress:reports/cucumber-progress.txt --format json > reports/cucumber.json
